title: OFSCP Discoverable Feed Delivery (push) (v0.1)
description: A fat feed push from the hub to a subscriber's callback (§8.4). Provider-signed (§8.1): the HTTP request carries provider-signing headers, and the embedded `provider`/`signature` fields make the stored payload verifiable independent of transport (mirroring §10). Subscribers dedupe by message id (§7.1) and apply created/updated/deleted by id.

topic.description: The discoverable feed URL this delivery belongs to.

kind.description: `created`/`updated` carry the full message; `deleted` carries a tombstone (id + deletedAt, content cleared).

cursor.description: Position of this event in the feed timeline (same cursor space as GET .../discoverable).

message.description: Full message (§5.3) for created/updated; a tombstone { id, deletedAt } for deleted.

provider.description: Domain of the signing (hub) provider; verified against its provider.publicKeys (§3.1, §8.1).

signature.description: Detached Ed25519 signature (base64) over the canonical delivery payload.
